question: Can the same nominal normalized 1e-6 stability threshold be guarded cheaply per frame without repeating a large factorization?

actual_scope.static_factor: One exact old-e41f La state, nominal sufficient numerical factor test only.
actual_scope.stage1: Finite sampled full native operator parity for that state; no uniform application-error bound.
actual_scope.changed_states: 32 separately admitted exact-state nominal certificate chains; no interpolation or trajectory admission follows.

recommendation.first_domain: Fixed cell, unchanged positive-alpha active map, topology, parameters, PME grid/split/boundary and response image bookkeeping.
recommendation.normalization: S = normalized native real/self operator + actual normalized H; retain intrinsic sqrt(alpha).
recommendation.anchor: One separately declared reference factor of S_ref - (tau_ref + mu)*I, mu>0 fixed prospectively, with unchanged qualified numerical factor/residual checks.
recommendation.per_frame_test: Admit only if a computed norm upper bound delta >= ||S_t-S_ref||_2 satisfies delta + tau_t - tau_ref < mu and all current-state/symmetry/domain checks pass.
recommendation.proof: Weyl gives lambda_min(S_t-tau_t I) > mu-delta+tau_ref-tau_t. The same sufficient reciprocal split and nominal odd allowance then apply.
recommendation.mu_semantics: A numerical reuse budget, not a new physical threshold. The existing bare SPD factors provide no quantitative mu. Positive pivots, PCG convergence, rcond or a few Ritz values cannot substitute.
recommendation.failure_semantics: Budget exhaustion is insufficient certificate, not proof of instability. Stop before induction or obtain a separately authorized exact-state certificate; no silent reuse or automatic refactor campaign.

cheap_path.real_change: Accumulate max_i sum_j ||Delta S_ij||_2 over symmetric 3x3 site blocks, including diagonal H change. This bounds the operator CHANGE and does not reopen the failed absolute Gershgorin shortcut. A proved upper bound on each block norm may replace its small spectral norm.
cheap_path.pair_bookkeeping: Use union of reference/current interacting pairs or a verified skin covering both; include lost/new cutoff pairs, exact scale/damping and minimum-image conventions. No resetting the reference to an uncertified frame.
cheap_path.PME: Use current initialized spline norm reductions for U_R and delta_odd; fixed-cell qfac data may be cached only under an exact immutable state key. No additional reciprocal FFT is required by these coefficient reductions. e_app remains unknown.
cheap_path.work: Additional work scales with covered real-pair count plus N*p^3 spline entries and mesh reductions; memory with pair cache plus mesh/site arrays. This is an operation-count statement, not measured per-frame performance.
cheap_path.rank_three_limit: H changes only a metal block, but moving solvent changes many native pair blocks. Rank-three H updates alone do not qualify a moving frame.
cheap_path.preconditioner_limit: Reusing the old factor for iterative solving can be useful separately, but is not stability admission.

minimal_engine_changes: Retain bound anchor geometry/operator identity, spare-shift certificate and positive-alpha map.
Compute symmetric difference bounds with native pair/list conventions, current collective H and correct cutoff crossing accounting.
Update current PME norm metadata after direct-field initialization and gate before either dual solve without changing RHS/trial arrays.
Invalidate on unsupported state changes; preserve original bypasses and solver behavior. Physical-image wrapping/tail-domain validity remains a separate guard.
next_finite_qualification_not_executed: Tiny dense checks for the implication, threshold-boundary rejection, missing-pair/cutoff and stale-state detection.
Use the two existing largest-step whole-box displacements to assess the change-bound conservatism without new native calls; these are finite perturbations, not representative dynamics.
If promising, separately declare one reserve-shift anchor factor and finite native-versus-saved accumulator parity. No margin value or factor release is selected here.
limitations: Existing static and changed-state numerical passes do not establish trajectory stability, finite-image validity for unrestricted diffusion, dynamics conservation or physical accuracy.
Ordinary-double numerical qualification is retained; no rigorous e_app or interval proof is invented or made a new prerequisite.
No claim of factor-per-frame practicality or of a useful refresh interval is supported.
Shared source authorship disclosed: this agent authored parts of the prior sparse/backend and Stage2 adapters; this assessment is a design recommendation, not an independent numerical qualification.
